title: Baseline release 2026.10.11: render again (`tend baseline render --write`)
body: ~ ci.contributors-only: CI runs only where the checks before a push can't stand in for it: a project open to contributions (it declares itself open, and its repo is public), on others' pull requests and pushes, and on its release tags when others build on its releases; or a check no machine here can run, even handed to another through a Nix remote builder (say which, and why, beside the workflow). Every other project has no workflows and GitHub Actions turned off. Its declared tests and gates run in git hooks: tend's checks before every commit, and all of them before every push. Projects are closed unless they say otherwise, and none is open yet.
